description: Convert between units of length, weight, temperature, data, speed and area. Real conversion tables with exact factors; temperature uses the proper C/F/K formulas.

faqs.a: Length, weight, data, speed and area use exact multiplicative factors. Temperature converts through Celsius with the standard formulas.
Temperature needs addition, not just multiplication: F = C x 9/5 + 32 and K = C + 273.15.
Data units use the binary standard: 1 KB = 1024 bytes, 1 MB = 1024 KB, and so on.

howto: Pick a category: Length, Weight, Temperature, Data, Speed or Area.
Choose the From and To units.
title: Unit Converter
